Works by . 3. I don't know what kind of name this is but his art is very good. Especially the animations. I was startled when I first saw the quality of the animations, despite them being few in number. His work is a breath of fresh air in this community since he uses neither CM3D2 nor Koikatsu. He makes the absolute most out of the software he uses. His work is amazing and I'm a fan.
